title: Voice Traffic Getting Dropped During Peak Hours
symptoms: VoIP calls have choppy audio during business hours
The issue clears after 6 PM when the office empties
Voice VLAN is properly configured on the access switches
rootCause: The QoS policy marking voice traffic with DSCP EF was applied to the wrong interface direction (inbound instead of outbound on the WAN link). Voice packets are being reclassified as best-effort and dropped during congestion.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the QoS service policy on an interface?
steps.hint: Look at the class-map matching and packet counters per class.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the class-map definitions and their match criteria?
steps.hint: Verify that voice traffic is actually being matched by the class-map.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the policy-map configuration to verify DSCP marking?
steps.hint: Confirm 'set dscp ef' is present and applied to the right class.
